note: This registry does NOT replace formal_dataset_manifest.json or formal_split_manifest.json and does not modify their content or hashes. It records the true annotation-source identity of the dataset those manifests describe, independently re-derived from the raw COCO files and split outputs on disk.

datasets.annotation_source_evidence: All 6 source COCO files (data/cvat_import_polygon_*_book_spine_iou0.5_book_spine.json) carry info.description == 'book_spine SAM3 pre-annotation (polygon ~8pts, NMS)'. 100% of 7185 annotation polygons have <=8 vertices, consistent with an unedited machine export and inconsistent with manual CVAT correction.
datasets.how_to_promote_to_formal: Re-export human-corrected polygons from CVAT for these images (or a superseding manual annotation batch), regenerate data_manifests/formal_dataset_manifest.json and formal_split_manifest.json from the corrected COCO files, add a NEW entry to this registry with a new dataset_id, human_reviewed=true, independently_corrected_gt=true, and allowed_for_formal_training=true only after independent verification of the correction.
